name: fixture-small-feature
instructions: Add a function `slugify(text)` to string_utils.py. It should lowercase the text, replace runs of spaces and underscores with a single hyphen, drop all other non-alphanumeric characters, collapse repeated hyphens, and strip leading/trailing hyphens. For example, 'Hello,  World_Again!' becomes 'hello-world-again'. Add tests for it alongside the existing ones.
